author: [deleted]
body: Change your GPS location accuracy in settings. High Accuracy uses WiFi and Bluetooth devices that have been scanned by Google and while they generally don't, it's possible they're interfering with your location.

author: Thorbimorbi
body:
I have the same problem since I changed my ISP and got a new router.

I know that sounds strange, but since then, my position keeps jumping, and not just in Orna. Google Maps also consistently places me in the wrong spot unless I am close to a window, my suspicion is that Android location service gets confused by the fact that the strongest WLAN around has a different (but standard) SSID now.

author: NaeKidsNaeProbs
body:
I facetiously call it "teleporting", it's fairly common but not enough to be disruptive. If it's going to happen then it's usually when the game starts up after a while being unused. 

Orna will have it even when everything else that uses the GPS is accurate (ingress, pokemon go, Google maps, etc) , one time it took me for an extended tour of an area about four miles away.
